report.summary: crates/document-statistics rev 3: no src/ changes. Added tests/adversarial_bounds.rs (14 tests) attacking the cache and scanner -- exact scan-byte-limit boundary, a 5000-document project, a single ~2MB item, combining-mark-only and zero-width-only text, revision id at u64::MAX, one source id re-registered 200 times with different content, an empty project, and 20000/5000-update churn proving cache.len() tracks distinct sources not update count -- every case a typed ScanTooLarge or a bounded Ok, never a panic. Added tests/stale_identity_acceptance.rs (5 tests) restating rev 2's property-tested contract as a specification: same revision+content is a trusted hit; same revision+changed content is a miss (the dangerous stale case); changed revision+same content is a miss; a sibling document's entry is untouched by either. 65 tests pass (was 46), clippy and fmt clean.
